title: Marble Printouts
warm:
Marble printouts of Vivienne's thinning calendar waited beside wine rings like Venn diagrams of complicity, and [player_name] learned what off-record night meant when intimacy and evidence shared the same stone. Nolan Greer's penthouse held Crownspire wind sheer against glass while Detective Imani Brooks hunted colder paper downstairs without a body. Four fates stayed open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Soft alibi heat had earned a body posture; now the calendar earned daylight on marble.

"Off-record," Nolan said, mid-forties, finance and tech holding, cufflinks quiet for once. "Means Brooks does not get this hour. Means Pell does not draft it. Means you and I read what Rhea's slate already whispered—weekly to monthly to gone—and decide whether want returns after, or whether we hand Brooks an ultimatum shape she will use."

[player_name]—early thirties, across the hall—touched a printout edge and felt ink threaten her pulse. Dates nested like accusations. Empty guest log marks. Concierge neutrality Rhea Quinn sold as privacy. Unused perfume still breathed from the master bath she should not know. Black car history lived in margins as curb-idle timestamps someone had been foolish enough to print.

Intimacy arrived as honesty with hands: Nolan's palm at her lower back while they leaned over marble, not yet a kiss, already a claim. Soft was pliable evidence; tonight soft was also the warmth between their shoulders. She could let want return mid-briefing—break the silence-war streak with desire as consequence—or steel herself toward Brooks's coming ultimatum: testify soft or be named complicit.

"If we choose want," she said, "we spend the printouts as foreplay for a fight we postpone." A beat. "If we choose Brooks's shape early, we walk into pressure before the wine finishes breathing."

Nolan's mouth tipped—brutal charm. "Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend the off-record hour. Soft alibi still fits your mouth; I need to know if it still fits your hands on me."

Elevator chime in the private shaft. Marcus Pell somewhere polishing traveling. Hope and dread shared every wine ring. [player_name] catalogued the marble the way a detective would and the way a lover would, and understood Layer 6 would not let those catalogues stay separate.

Choice waited as verbs: return to want, or face the ultimatum shape before dawn. Across the hall, clearer conscience; here, printouts and pulse. Soft cooperation off-record had become a bed and a briefing at once.

His hand slid from printout edge to her waist, thumb counting ribs. "Want returns—or we harden toward Brooks's ultimatum while you're still wet from standing this close. Choose before I finish the almost-kiss."

She clenched around absence and evidence at once. Soft alibi had a pulse hammering between legs and throat. She could break silence-war with desire mid-briefing, fucking the night later against glass after printouts became pillow talk—or steel into testify-soft-or-complicit pressure while his breath still warmed her jaw.
